criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 5's isotype counts to exactly 40 at full size, matching behind_the_meter.units. Frame 8's cartography is checkable: the -103 meridian lands at 27.5 percent of the state's drawn width and the Odessa mark sits just south of the 32N line. Against that, frame 3's 28 ruled lines render as moire against the cell 6 screen and cannot be counted at all, and frame 8's ODESSA leader runs collinear with the 32N line so far West Texas reads as a rectangular bar.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The accent law holds frame by frame on the contact sheet. Against it, frame 3 measures 37.7 L* against a deck otherwise running 11.9 to 21.1, so it is frame 3 rather than the declared cut at frame 4 that a reader sees strobe. Separately, storyboard slide 8 describes a frame that was not built: two marks in composition.structure and value_structure, one mark in the acceptance list and one in the render.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Two hard fails plus a pattern of narrowing errors. Strengths first: compute.py extracts every figure from a quote by regex, the one typed date is disclosed rather than hidden, quantifiers.json declares a universal no gate flagged, and frame 8 prints the refusal. The failures are the web edition's grid resource sentence and frame 9's applicant attribution. Lesser stretches: c4 says report by Monday October 19 and frames 7 and 9 render it as an event; c8's approximately over 474 becomes a flat 474 in frame 4's dek; the caption's c22 fact carries no claim id on the reader's path; frame 2's best line is the deck's one undeclared generic.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The two scopes argument is genuinely clear and names the body, the county, the places and the deadline. What it cannot do is let a reader act: texan_check read next step NO, the Abilene comment route was cut with the unverifiable finding, and nothing replaced it.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn at frame 4 is declared rather than discovered and it is the right place. Frame 7's tick runs measure 1358 px for 49 and 780 px for 28, a ratio of 0.574 against a true 0.571, so the single pitch the storyboard promised is actually there. Frame 6 adds least.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Lines a person wrote, with concrete regional specificity and no boosterism. House rules held everywhere checked. Marked down only because the best line on frame 2 is also the deck's one undeclared generic.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Third Governor's office directive to a state agency about data centers in ten days, dedupe_check LIKELY REPEAT at 0.72 against no. 29. The override rests on two reasons and the run's own appendix voids the second, since the texan_check profile that was the stated mitigation evaporated and the override was never revisited. The ledger's precedent cuts the other way twice, at 0.70 and 0.74. Craft variety is real and measured, which is the only reason this is not lower.

hard_fails: An unverified fact presented as verified, and one the run's own record explicitly refuses. ledger/articles/2026-09-23.json: 'The plant it buys from is a grid resource.' cited to c19, c20, c21 and tracing to none of them. claims.json's rejected block, figures.json's adjacent_plant block and the storyboard each record the sentence as dead. It directly contradicts frame 8 of the deck it accompanies.

An unverified fact presented as verified. slide-09's dek: 'sought by Vantage Data Centers TX11'. c12's quote is the hearing caption only and neither its text nor its quote states an applicant. The clause was ADDED in round 4, the web edition written from the same record declines to name an applicant, and the run refuses the sibling inference from the same page one bullet away in rejected.
one_sentence_fix: Before declaring any fact-check refusal repaired, grep every committed artifact for the refuted PROPOSITION rather than for the sentence a scorer quoted.
